summary: Package exfiltrates browser cookies and storage to hardcoded external endpoint
details: The package's main module reads document.cookie, document.localStorage, and document.sessionStorage and POSTs each value to the hardcoded endpoint https://c-b34596407b6d47d6.dgactf-challs.site/addPost via a sendPost helper. Any web application that bundles this package will silently transmit end-user session data (including authentication cookies and any secrets stored in localStorage/sessionStorage) to that non-first-party host whenever the bundle loads in a user's browser. There is no documented purpose, no caller-configurable destination, and no opt-out; the destination is a fixed subdomain unrelated to the package name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
